Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: kondagaon.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ITI Kondagaon Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Lecturer (COPA) position at ITI Kondagaon is 12th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Lecturer (COPA) role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have completed High School or equivalent, possess an NCVT/NAC certificate in COPA or an equivalent technical qualification, and ideally have a BCA/PGDCA or DOEACC 'A' level or a Computer Science degree. CTI/ATI qualifications are preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for this post is 18 years. The maximum age limit is not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The salary is offered at Rs. 140 per hour, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 15,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a merit list prepared from the marks obtained in the technical qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer (COPA) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Lecturer (COPA) position at ITI Kondagaon.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Industrial Training Institute Kondagaon.

faq.question: Q10. Where is ITI Kondagaon located?
faq.answer: Industrial Training Institute Kondagaon is located in Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 494331.
